references.text: Zipporah circumcised her son with a flint knife, illustrating the ancient practice of using stone knives for circumcision, just as Joshua used flint knives.
God's covenant with Abraham, which required circumcision as a sign of the covenant, forms the basis for the circumcision Joshua performed on the sons of Israel.
Circumcision was required before one could participate in the Passover meal, explaining why Joshua circumcised the people before they celebrated Passover in Canaan.
The preceding verse where the Lord commands Joshua to make flint knives and circumcise the sons of Israel again.
The explanation for why this circumcision was necessary: those born in the wilderness had not been circumcised.
Moses urges the people to circumcise their hearts, highlighting the spiritual significance behind the physical circumcision that Joshua performed.
